title: Search my machines and my friends
placeholder: Your question, e.g.: when does the moon rocket take off?
where: Your question will go to {machines}, and nowhere else: each one searches what it has opened to you and sends back only a few passages, not its files.
nobody_opens: None of your paired machines has opened a library to you yet. Each one sets this in its library ⋯ menu, “Searchable by…”; it shows up here within a minute.
status_closed: no longer opens anything to you
question_too_long: Question too long ({max} characters at most).
rate_limited: “{name}” limits searches to {limit} per minute: try again in {wait} s.
set_aside: “{name}” no longer lets you search its libraries: {reason}.
refused_phone: phone not charging or not on Wi-Fi
phone: “{name}” is a phone: it only searches for its friends while charging and on Wi-Fi.
chatting: “{name}” is answering a conversation: try again in a moment.
busy: “{name}” is busy with other searches: try again in a moment.
no_ollama: “{name}” can't search right now: Ollama isn't answering there in time.
not_paired: This machine is no longer paired.
